title: Readiness Estimator: Decision Journal Platforms
definition: Estimates Decision Journal Platforms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Decision Journal Platforms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Decision Journal Platforms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Decision Journal Platforms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Decision Journal Platforms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 89876 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where decision templates monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or review rituals maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Decision Journal Platforms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Decision Journal Platforms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Decision Journal Platforms — platforms for journaling decisions.

Phase 1 — Prove (decision templates): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (review rituals): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (outcome tracking): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and professionals-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
